# soundmode: Dolby-like 7.1 headphone virtualizer for "CABLE Input" (VB-Audio), set to 7.1 in Windows.
# HRIR = Dolby Atmos for Headphones, Movie/Balanced, measured per speaker (dolby-probe/runs/sur_dolby_movie).
# Output: binaural L/R; CABLE Output is played to the headphones with "Listen to this device".
If: outputChannelCount == 8
  Channel: SUB
  Filter: ON LP Fc 120 Hz
  Copy: L0=L R1=L SL0=SL SR1=SL RL0=RL RR1=RL C0=C R0=R L1=R SR0=SR SL1=SR RR0=RR RL1=RR C1=C
  Channel: L0 R1 SL0 SR1 RL0 RR1 C0 R0 L1 SR0 SL1 RR0 RL1 C1
  If: sampleRate == 48000
    Convolution: sur_dolby_movie_48.wav
  Else:
    Convolution: sur_dolby_movie_44.wav
  EndIf:
  Copy: L=L0+SL0+RL0+C0+L1+SL1+RL1+0.3*SUB R=R1+SR1+RR1+R0+SR0+RR0+C1+0.3*SUB
  Copy: C=0 SUB=0 RL=0 RR=0 SL=0 SR=0
  # level back toward Dolby (HRIR was exported at -16 dB), peaks held by the TDR Nova safety limiter (-1 dBFS)
  Channel: L R
  Preamp: 12 dB
  VSTPlugin: Library "C:\Program Files\EqualizerAPO\config\VST\TDR Nova.dll" ChunkData ""
EndIf:
